name: Time Keeper
description: Sends a quote and the day's schedule each morning, plus a look at tomorrow before bed, with times and street addresses attached to entries. Depends on a connected calendar that is actually kept up to date, since it reports what is there rather than filling gaps.

official.title: Time Keeper by Mark
official.description: A calendar assistant that sends a morning digest (one good quote, then the day) and a next-day briefing every night. Puts times and street addresses on...
